take: Winnipeg announced it has activated defenseman Josh Morrissey from injured reserve and assigned defenseman Henry Thrun to Manitoba of the AHL. Morrissey played 21:24 a night on the second pair and the first power-play unit in six games this season, and when he is on the ice at five-on-five, Winnipeg's share of expected goals (the quality of chances) rises by about five percentage points. That matters for a team sitting at 9-8-3 with a 48 percent share overall. Haydn Fleury, at 12:56 a night, is next in line for the minutes Morrissey's return will take back.
